findings.summary: The fp32 upcast happens after original_sd = model.state_dict() is captured (line 649), so with cpu_ram_efficient_loading and mixed precision rank 0 broadcasts bf16/fp16 tensors while other ranks allocate fp32 buffers, risking garbage weights, NCCL errors or hangs.

Any Params4bit in the model causes the upcast to be skipped for the whole model, so QLoRA models with bf16 adapters and fp32 norms keep mixed dtypes, a regression from the old code that upcast regardless.
